title: A Differential Drive That Slips: Wheel Speeds to Motion, With the Two Losses a Real Floor Adds, and What Each Costs in Distance and in Turn

artifact.note: a differential drive model from the two wheel speeds, with a longitudinal slip (ground speed is less than wheel speed) and a turn efficiency (the body turns less than the wheels say), integrated with the midpoint heading, and the inverse: the efficiency read back from a measured turn
